name: Transmission (gearbox)
summary: The gearbox lets the engine stay in its useful speed range whether the car is crawling or cruising.
whatItDoes: An engine only makes useful power within a band of speeds. The gearbox picks a gear ratio so the engine can pull away from a stop with plenty of force, and still cruise at motorway speed without revving too high. It also gives you reverse.
howItWorks: Pairs of gears of different sizes give different ratios. In a manual gearbox you choose the pair with the gear lever. In an automatic, the transmission chooses for you using planetary gear sets and clutches, or a belt and pulleys (CVT). In front-wheel-drive cars, the gearbox and differential share one case called a transaxle, which sends power to both front axles.
failureSymptoms: Whining or humming that changes with road speed
Fluid leaks under the middle of the car
safetyNotes: Very heavy. Never get under it while it is unsupported.
Gear oil and automatic transmission fluid can be hot after driving.
